El profesional será responsable de la configuración, pruebas de aceptación en fábrica (FAT), pruebas en sitio (SAT) y puesta en marcha de sistemas de protección, control y supervisión para subestaciones y sistemas eléctricos de media y alta tensión. La posición requiere sólidos conocimientos técnicos en relés de protección, sistemas SCADA, redes de comunicaciones y automatización de subestaciones, así como, experiencia en actividades de comisionamiento y soporte técnico durante la ejecución de proyectos. Principales responsabilidades • Configurar y parametrizar relés de protección y dispositivos inteligentes (IEDs) de Distintas Marcas. • Ejecutar pruebas FAT y SAT de sistemas de protección, control y medición. • Realizar actividades de puesta en marcha y comisionamiento de sistemas eléctricos en instalaciones de clientes. • Validar la operación funcional de esquemas de protección, control y supervisión. • Integrar equipos de protección y control con sistemas SCADA y plataformas de automatización. • Elaborar protocolos de prueba, reportes técnicos y documentación de comisionamiento. • Interpretar diagramas unifilares, esquemas funcionales, diagramas de control y comunicaciones. • Brindar soporte técnico a equipos Comercial, Ingeniería, ejecución y mantenimiento. • Garantizar el cumplimiento de los estándares de calidad, seguridad y ciberseguridad aplicables a los proyectos. Requisitos Formación • Título profesional de Ingeniería Eléctrica, Ingeniería Civil Eléctrica, o carrera afín. Experiencia • Mínimo 4 años de experiencia en sistemas de protección y control. • Experiencia comprobada en: • Configuración y parametrización de relés de protección. • Pruebas de aceptación en fábrica (FAT). • Pruebas de aceptación en sitio (SAT). • Puesta en marcha y comisionamiento de sistemas de protección y control. • Subestaciones eléctricas de media y/o alta tensión. • Uso de Equipo de Inyección Secundaria Omicron, Megger, ISA.   Conocimientos técnicos • Relés de protección y control (ABB, GE, SEL, SE, Siemens, entre otras) de AT, MT y BT • Lectura e interpretación de diagramas eléctricos y lógicos. • Protocolos de comunicación: IEC 61850, DNP3, Modbus. • Sistemas SCADA y automatización de subestaciones. • Softwares de modelamiento DigSILENT, ETAP, entre otros. • Redes Ethernet industriales, protocolos de redundancia (PRP, HSR, RSTP), sincronización horaria (SNTP/PTP/IRIG-B) y ciberseguridad (Deseable).   Idiomas   • Inglés Medio (deseable).   Requisitos adicionales • Disponibilidad para viajes dentro de Chile y eventualmente al extranjero. • Disponibilidad para trabajar en terreno durante actividades de comisionamiento y puesta en marcha. Deseable: Experiencia en proyectos Mantenimiento de Sub-Estaciones Eléctricas diurnos y vespertinas, en rubros de Generación, Transmisión, Distribución en sectores de Energía, Renovables e Industrias.

review_candidates.description: Career Opportunities: Head of Project Sudan (14632) Requisition ID 14632 - Posted 09/30/2026 - Kassala - Full Time  Job Description Print Preview Are you looking for a meaningful job where you can invest your skills, passion, and time in an impactful way? Do you want to work for an organization that is dynamic, goal-driven, and dedicated to making a difference? Welcome to Welthungerhilfe! Welthungerhilfe (WHH) is one of Germany’s largest private aid organizations. Politically and religiously independent, we work toward a world without hunger. Together with national and international partners, we respond to humanitarian crises and support long-term solutions that improve the living conditions for the most vulnerable people. We change and shape food systems, we are locally-led and globally connected. As an impact-oriented and human-centered organization, we use innovation, evidence and data-informed decision-making to continuously improve our work and contribute to #Zero Hunger. Our vision: "Zero Hunger on a Healthy Planet." Join us in creating a world where everyone has access to food while ensuring a sustainable future for our planet. If you are ready to make an impact, we look forward to receiving your application! Head of Project Sudan* in Kassala The position is to be filled as of 1st of January 2027, with an initial contract duration of one year. There are very good prospects for an extension. Employment location will be Kassala, Sudan (SD) . As Head of Project you will be responsible for the effective management and implementation of our projects in Kassala State, ensuring that activities are delivered on time, within budget and in line with Welthungerhilfe and donor requirements. You will oversee project coordination, planning, implementation and reporting, while ensuring the appropriate and efficient use of project funds. In close coordination with Welthungerhilfe's regional office and relevant partners, you will contribute to the successful delivery of the projects and their inteneded results. Through your work, you will contribute to strengthening civil society and improving access to services for maginalized communities in Kassala State. Your responsibilities Manage and implement the project(s) in line with donor requirements and Welthungerhilfe standards, ensuring effective planning, monitoring, budgeting, logistics, finance, and administration. Continuously review and adapt project plans and budgets and report on progress, challenges, and risks to the Country Director/Area Manager. Build and maintain effective working relationships with donors and other relevant stakeholders across humanitarian, rehabilitation, and development programming, in coordination with the Country Office. Manage and recruit project staff in line with Welthungerhilfe's leadership principles, policies, and strategy, and ensure effective project office management where applicable. Ensure the implementation and appropriate adaptation of Welthungerhilfe policies, including the establishment and maintenance of the project's security management system and preparedness arrangements for potential crises and disasters. Represent Welthungerhilfe with relevant national and international stakeholders and strengthen networks with civil society, government, academia, and other partners, in coordination with the Country Office. Support public relations and Welthungerhilfe's local visibility and accompany visiting donors, Head Office staff, and journalists or ensure appropriate representation when required. Contribute to country strategy development, strategic planning, and Country Management discussions, and take on other tasks relevant to the position as assigned by management. Your profile Higher university degree in Agriculture, Project Management, Community Development, Social Sciences, or another related field. At least 7 years’ professional experience on project coordination and management of project expenditure/ plans with international organization. Experience in planning, leading and coordinating with other partners at the field level. Experience on managing teams and working with donor fund project. Advance knowledge on MS Office skills (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Access) is mandatory. Strong communication on spoken and writing English language is mandatory. Knowleedge of Arabic is an asset. Our offer We offer you the opportunity to work in a responsible and interesting field as part of an extremely dedicated team. Welthungerhilfe attaches great importance to the personal and professional development of its employees. Remuneration is based on our gender-independent salary scale. Please send your application via our online recruiting system by October 18, 2026. Your contact person is Ina Stepka. Welthungerhilfe is committed to fighting terrorism in all its activities. Accordingly, any applicant who is offered employment will be screened against lists of known and suspected terrorists. Welthungerhilfe values diversity and ensures an inclusive, non-discriminatory working environment. We welcome applications from suitably qualified people from all sections of the community. Our Code of Conduct Find out more about Welthungerhilfe's behavioural and work principles. Our Projects We fight against hunger and poverty by implementing projects in numerous countries. Our Strategy "Zero Hunger by 2030" Our strategy guides us in our work. Transparency and Quality Welthungerhilfe, its employees, as well as its partners commit to transparency and quality. review_candidates.description: Job Description Summary Job Description HVDC Primary & Valve Installation Supervisor (m/f/d) GE Vernova is facing a momentum of hypergrowth, and we are currently scaling up our teams, creating others from scratch, and bringing our industry to the next level. Join us on this mission! At GE Vernova Grid Solutions we are electrifying the world with advanced grid technologies. As leaders in the energy space our goal is to accelerate the transition for a more energy efficient grid to full fill the needs of tomorrow. With a focus on growth and sustainability GE Vernova Grid Solutions plays a pivotable role in integrating Renewables onto the grid to drive to carbon neutral. Due to the growth of our HVDC business, we are currently looking for our next HVDC Primary & Valve Installation Supervisor in the “Construction & Commissioning” function to participate in this energy transition. Your Mission: Within our large scale HVDC Projects you are responsible for the Supervision of the Installation for our HVDC Valves including the Valve Cooling System. The installation will be done by subcontractors. This position implies functional leadership as an IC (Individual Contributor) without direct reports. It is a Construction Site based role. Join us and enjoy playing a major role to enhance the Central Europe Construction & Commissioning function with fresh ideas! Main Tasks/Responsibilities: 1. EHS Ensure all installation activities are performed in accordance with safety protocols and regulatory requirements. 2. Quality Oversight Implement quality control measures to ensure the reliability and performance of installed HVDC Valves & HVDC Primary Equipment. Conduct inspections based on ITPs to verify adherence to quality standards. Prepare and review installation documentation, test reports, and as-built drawings. Ensure all tools, equipment, and materials are properly maintained and stored 3. Planning & Coordination Coordinate the HVDC Primary Equipment & Valve installation activities with the Site Management Team and other internal and external stakeholders (Installation Subcontractor) on site. Providing guidance, training and support as needed to the installation subcontractor Coordinate with our internal Valve manufacturing to assure needed documentation is used at site during execution Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues that arise during the installation process Your Profile: Technical education, preferably with a degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering or equivalent experience in electrical- or mechanical installation works in large scale projects with at least 3 years experience in the relevant field. Experience from Supervision or Site Management in substation, FACTS or HVDC Projects preferred. Strong health and safety mindset aligned with international standards, with the ability to identify and stop unsafe work. Strong interpersonal, communication, and leadership skills, with the ability to provide clear verbal and written reporting (English required). Proactive mindset with the ability to recommend and approve corrective actions. Why we come to work: At GE Vernova, our employees are always up for the challenge - and we’re always driven to find the best solution. Our projects are unique and interesting, and you’ll need to bring a solution-focused, positive approach to each one to do your best. Surrounded by committed, loyal colleagues, if you can dare to bring your ingenuity and desire to make an impact, you’ll be exposed to game-changing, diverse projects that truly allow you to play your part in the energy transition. What we offer: Professional Growth: Dynamic team, extensive resources, and training for skill development A Booming industry with Cutting-Edge Projects: Involvement in high-profile, innovative projects Global Exposure: Collaboration with a diverse, global network of industry experts Collaborative Environment: Supportive culture fostering creativity and teamwork A macro-management culture with flexible working hours and a stable career Competitive compensation package plus corporate benefits Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: No - This is a remote position
